comment: The study participant number is the CDISC SUBJID concept; rejected NCIT:C69256 Subject Unique Identifier, which is the identifier unique across studies.
The variable records the recruiting centre, i.e. the study site; rejected NCIT:C83081 Study Site Identifier because the description names the centre, not an identifier code.
Biological sex recorded at screening is the NCIT/CDISC Sex concept; rejected NCIT:C124436 Sex at Birth, which is the neonatal designation.
NCIT Birth Year (synonym Year of Birth) is the year in which a person was born.
Years of formal education completed matches NCIT Number of Years of Education (EDUYRNUM); rejected NCIT:C17953 Education Level, which is categorical.
Dominant hand (R/L/both) is the NCIT Dominant Hand attribute; no handedness term exists in HPO.
Date of baseline enrolment matches NCIT Study Subject Enrolled Date (synonym Date of Enrollment); rejected NCIT:C164338 Age of Enrollment.
Date informed consent signed is the CDISC RFICDAT concept NCIT Informed Consent Date.

No NCIT term for family history of Parkinson disease in a first-degree relative exists, so the general Family Medical History term is broader; rejected MONDO:0005180 Parkinson disease because the participant's own diagnosis is not recorded.
A clinical diagnosis of idiopathic PD is a diagnosis mapped to MONDO Parkinson disease; rejected MONDO:0021095 parkinsonian disorder as too broad and HP:0001300 Parkinsonism as a phenotype.
MSA parkinsonian variant is MONDO multiple system atrophy, parkinsonian type (synonym MSA-p); rejected MONDO:0007803 multiple system atrophy as broader.
Clinical PSP diagnosis maps to MONDO progressive supranuclear palsy; rejected the PSP subtype syndromes such as MONDO:0009839 PSP-parkinsonism as narrower.
MONDO Lewy body dementia carries the synonyms dementia with Lewy bodies and DLB; no separate DLB term was found.

NCIT Age Symptom Started (synonym Age at Symptom Onset) covers any first symptom, so it is broader than age at first motor symptom; rejected NCIT:C124353 Symptom Onset, which is a time point, not an age.
NCIT Age at Diagnosis is generic (defined for initial pathologic diagnosis), so it is broader than age at PD diagnosis; no PD-specific or clinical-diagnosis age term was found.

A LRRK2 G2019S carrier status is related to the LRRK2 genetic disease PARK8 per the guidelines; rejected LOINC:82139-7, a targeted analysis of two variants (R1441G and G2019S) rather than the carrier status.
Bradykinesia on exam is a sign mapped to HPO Bradykinesia.
Rest tremor in any limb is HPO Resting tremor; rejected HP:0001337 Tremor as broader.
Rigidity on exam maps to HPO Rigidity; rejected HP:0007076 Extrapyramidal muscular rigidity and HP:0002396 Cogwheel rigidity because the variable does not specify the type.
Postural instability on the pull test is HPO Postural instability, whose definition cites the retropulsion test.
Freezing episodes when walking is HPO Freezing of gait.
Self-reported reduced sense of smell is the symptom HPO Hyposmia; rejected HP:0010635 Partial hyposmia as narrower.
No sense of smell is HPO Anosmia; rejected HP:0010632 Total anosmia as narrower and NCIT:C116369 because HPO takes precedence for symptoms.
Reported dream enactment is a symptom, so HPO REM sleep behavior disorder is used; rejected MONDO:0005937 REM sleep behavior disorder because the guidelines put symptoms in HPO.
Fewer than 3 bowel movements a week or laxative use defines the symptom HPO Constipation; rejected HP:0012450 Chronic constipation as narrower.
A drop of at least 20/10 mmHg on standing is HPO Orthostatic hypotension; rejected HP:0004926 Orthostatic hypotension due to autonomic dysfunction as narrower.
Urinary urgency maps to HPO Urinary urgency.

A clinician-judged diagnosis of depression is a disease diagnosis, so MONDO depressive disorder is used; rejected HP:0000716 Depression (symptom) and MONDO:0002009 major depressive disorder (narrower).
Visual hallucinations in the last month is HPO Visual hallucination; rejected HP:0000738 Hallucinations as broader.
PD-MCI by MDS Level II criteria is a subtype of mild cognitive impairment, and neither MONDO nor HPO has an MCI term; rejected HP:0100543 Cognitive impairment as more general still.
HPO has no levodopa-induced dyskinesia term, so the broader HPO Dyskinesia is used; rejected HP:0040141 Tardive dyskinesia, which is neuroleptic-induced.
Difficulty swallowing is HPO Dysphagia.

object_label: Movement Disorder Society Unified Parkinson's Disease Rating Scale Questionnaire
comment: No LOINC or NCIT term exists for the MDS-UPDRS Part I total, so the MDS-UPDRS questionnaire is broader; rejected LOINC UPDRS codes, which are the original UPDRS.

object_label: Movement Disorder Society Unified Parkinson's Disease Rating Scale Questionnaire
comment: No LOINC or NCIT term exists for the MDS-UPDRS Part II total, so the MDS-UPDRS questionnaire is broader; rejected LOINC:77719-3, the original UPDRS ADL panel.

object_label: Movement Disorder Society Unified Parkinson's Disease Rating Scale Questionnaire
comment: No term exists for the MDS-UPDRS Part III total in the OFF state, so the MDS-UPDRS questionnaire is broader; rejected NCIT:C111615 UPDRS - Motor Examination Sub-total, which is the original UPDRS.

object_label: Movement Disorder Society Unified Parkinson's Disease Rating Scale Questionnaire
comment: No term exists for the MDS-UPDRS Part III total in the ON state, so the MDS-UPDRS questionnaire is broader; rejected NCIT:C111615 UPDRS - Motor Examination Sub-total, which is the original UPDRS.

object_label: Movement Disorder Society Unified Parkinson's Disease Rating Scale Questionnaire
comment: No term exists for the MDS-UPDRS Part IV total, so the MDS-UPDRS questionnaire is broader; rejected LOINC:77721-9, the original UPDRS complications panel.
Hoehn and Yahr rated in MDS-UPDRS III is NCIT MDS-UPDRS - Hoehn and Yahr Stage; rejected LOINC:77714-4 and NCIT:C100943, which are the modified Hoehn and Yahr of the original UPDRS.
The MoCA total out of 30 is LOINC Total score [MoCA]; rejected LOINC:72133-2, the MoCA panel, and NCIT:C162720 because LOINC takes precedence.

object_label: Geriatric depression scale (GDS) short version total
comment: The GDS-15 short form total is LOINC GDS short version total; rejected LOINC:48544-1, the 30-item GDS total.
No LOINC or NCIT term exists for the ESS total score, so the ESS questionnaire is the broader match.

object_label: Scales for Outcomes in Parkinson's Disease - Autonomic Dysfunction Questionnaire
comment: No LOINC or NCIT term exists for the SCOPA-AUT total score, so the SCOPA-AUT questionnaire is the broader match.

object_label: Schwab England activities of daily living scale [UPDRS]
comment: The Schwab and England ADL % independence score is in LOINC, although it is coded within the original UPDRS panel; rejected NCIT:C111611 because LOINC takes precedence and LOINC:77716-9 because it is the with-dyskinesia rating.
No LOINC or NCIT term was found for the University of Pennsylvania Smell Identification Test; rejected NCIT:C17139 Olfaction and NCIT:C139027 Odor Detection as not this test.

object_label: REM Sleep Behavior Disorder Screening Questionnaire
comment: No LOINC or NCIT term exists for the RBDSQ total score, so the RBDSQ questionnaire is the broader match.
No LOINC code exists for an alpha-synuclein seed amplification assay result in CSF, so the analyte alpha-synuclein is related; rejected LOINC:49456-7, which is immunostaining in tissue.

Maximum ThT fluorescence (RFU) of the alpha-synuclein SAA is a relative-unit readout with no LOINC code, so it is related only to the analyte; rejected any concentration test and NCIT:C218853 Thioflavin T (the dye).

No LOINC mass-concentration code exists for alpha-synuclein in CSF, so the NCIT protein is related per the guidelines; rejected NCIT:C142272 Alpha Synuclein Protein Measurement and LOINC:49456-7 (tissue immunostain).

object_label: Amyloid beta 42 peptide [Mass/volume] in Cerebrospinal Fluid
comment: Amyloid beta 1-42 in CSF in pg/mL agrees with this code on component, CSF specimen and mass/volume property; rejected the plasma code LOINC:33200-7.
Total tau in CSF in pg/mL matches this code on component, specimen and mass/volume, with no method stated; rejected LOINC:101649-2, which adds an immunoassay method the variable does not state.

object_label: Phosphorylated tau 181 [Mass/volume] in Cerebrospinal Fluid by Immunoassay
comment: Phospho-tau 181 in CSF by immunoassay in pg/mL agrees with this code on component, specimen, mass/volume and method; rejected the plasma code LOINC:103675-5.

object_label: Neurofilament light chain [Mass/volume] in Serum or Plasma by Immunoassay
comment: Serum NfL by Simoa (an immunoassay) in pg/mL matches this Ser/Plas mass/volume immunoassay code; rejected LOINC:112614-3, which is moles/volume in plasma.

object_label: Neurofilament light chain [Moles/volume] in Plasma by Immunoassay
comment: Plasma NfL in pmol/L requires a moles/volume code, and this is the plasma one; rejected LOINC:101281-4, which is mass/volume.

object_label: Neurofilament light chain [Mass/volume] in Cerebrospinal Fluid
comment: CSF NfL in ng/L is mass/volume in CSF and matches this code.
A SomaScan RFU value has no LOINC code and is never a concentration test, so it is related to the NCIT GPNMB protein; rejected NCIT:C113114 GPNMB Gene.
An Olink NPX value has no LOINC code and is never a concentration test, so it is related to the NCIT GPNMB protein; rejected NCIT:C113114 GPNMB Gene.
An Olink Explore NPX value for cathepsin B has no LOINC code, so it is related to the NCIT Cathepsin B protein; rejected NCIT:C28405 CTSB Gene.

object_label: C reactive protein [Mass/volume] in Serum or Plasma by High sensitivity method
comment: Serum high-sensitivity CRP in mg/L matches this code on component, specimen, mass/volume and high-sensitivity method; rejected LOINC:1988-5, which has no high-sensitivity method.
Serum uric acid in umol/L requires the moles/volume code; rejected LOINC:3084-1, which is mass/volume.
HbA1c as % of total haemoglobin is the mass fraction in blood with no method stated; rejected LOINC:17856-6 (by HPLC) and LOINC:41995-2 (mass/volume).
Red cell count in CSF per uL is the number concentration with no method stated; rejected LOINC:792-2 (manual count) and LOINC:791-4 (automated count).

Fasted more than 8 h before the blood draw (y/n) is the fasting status at specimen collection; rejected NCIT:C93566 Fasting Status Indicator and NCIT:C120460 Fasting Status as less specific to the draw.
No NCIT term was found for the number of freeze-thaw cycles of a specimen; rejected NCIT:C158280 Thawed Specimen and NCIT:C48165 Thaw as not a count.
No NCIT or LOINC term was found for DaT-SPECT specific binding ratio in the putamen; rejected NCIT:C95006 Binding Potential and NCIT:C12452 Putamen as different concepts.
No NCIT or LOINC term was found for DaT-SPECT specific binding ratio in the caudate; rejected NCIT:C95006 Binding Potential and NCIT:C12451 Caudate Nucleus as different concepts.
The assay plate or batch identifier matches NCIT Assay Plate Identifier; rejected NCIT:C104504 Batch Number, a manufacturing lot.
No NCIT term exists for levodopa equivalent daily dose, so the general Daily Dose is broader; rejected NCIT:C611 Levodopa because LEDD sums all antiparkinsonian drugs.
ON/OFF at the motor exam is the MDS-UPDRS Part III clinical-state item; rejected NCIT:C100538 MDS-UPDRS - Time Spent in the Off State.
